translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the second year of Yongchun he died at home, at the age of eighty-two, and was posthumously granted the title of Area Commander of Yuezhou.

sentences.zh: 智周少與鄉人蔣子慎善，同詣善相者，曰：「明公位極人臣，而胤嗣微弱；

translations.literal: When Zhi Zhou was young he was on good terms with his fellow townsman Jiang Zishen; together they visited a skilled fortune-teller, who said: "Your Excellency will reach the highest rank among ministers, yet your descendants will be weak;
translations.idiomatic: When Zhi Zhou was young he was on good terms with his fellow townsman Jiang Zishen; together they visited a skilled fortune-teller, who said, "Your Excellency will reach the highest rank among ministers, yet your descendants will be weak;

sentences.zh: 蔣侯官祿至薄，而子孫轉盛。

translations.literal: Marquis Jiang's official salary and rank will be very modest, yet his descendants will flourish.
translations.idiomatic: Marquis Jiang's official salary and rank will be very modest, yet his descendants will flourish.

sentences.zh: 」子慎後累年為建安尉卒，其子繪來謁智周。

translations.literal: " Years later Zishen served for many years as magistrate of Jian'an and then died; his son Hui came to visit Zhi Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: " Years later Zishen served for many years as magistrate of Jian'an and then died; his son Hui came to visit Zhi Zhou.

sentences.zh: 智周已貴矣，曰：「吾與子父有故，子復有才。

translations.literal: Zhi Zhou was already eminent by then and said: "I had an old friendship with your father, and you too have talent.
translations.idiomatic: Zhi Zhou was already eminent by then and said, "I had an old friendship with your father, and you too have talent.

sentences.zh: 」因以女妻之。

translations.literal: " Accordingly he gave his daughter to him in marriage.
translations.idiomatic: " Accordingly he gave his daughter to him in marriage.

sentences.zh: 永淳中，為緱氏尉、鄭州司兵卒。

translations.literal: During the Yongchun era he served as magistrate of Gou and military registrar of Zhengzhou, and then died.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yongchun era he served as magistrate of Gou and military registrar of Zhengzhou, and then died.

sentences.zh: 繪子捷，舉進士。

translations.literal: Hui's son Jie passed the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: Hui's son Jie passed the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 開元中，歷臺省，仕至湖、延二州刺史。

translations.literal: During the Kaiyuan era he served in the central secretariat and censorate, and reached the posts of prefect of Hu and Yan.
translations.idiomatic: During the Kaiyuan era he served in the central secretariat and censorate, and reached the posts of prefect of Hu and Yan.

sentences.zh: 子貴，贈揚州大都督。

translations.literal: His son was ennobled, and he was posthumously granted the title of Area Commander of Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: His son was ennobled, and he was posthumously granted the title of Area Commander of Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 捷子冽、渙，並進士及第。

translations.literal: Jie's sons Lie and Huan both passed the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: Jie's sons Lie and Huan both passed the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 冽，歷禮、吏、戶部三侍郎，尚書左丞；

translations.literal: Lie served as Vice Minister of Rites, Personnel, and Revenue in succession, and as Left Vice Director of the Secretariat;
translations.idiomatic: Lie served as Vice Minister of Rites, Personnel, and Revenue in succession, and as Left Vice Director of the Secretariat;

sentences.zh: 渙，天寶末給事中，永泰初右散騎常侍。

translations.literal: Huan, in the late Tianbao era served as Chief Drafting Officer, and in the early Yongtai era served as Right Regular Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: Huan, in the late Tianbao era served as Chief Drafting Officer, and in the early Yongtai era served as Right Regular Attendant.

sentences.zh: 高氏殄滅已久，果符相者之言。

translations.literal: The Gao clan had long since been extinguished, confirming the fortune-teller's words.
translations.idiomatic: The Gao clan had long since been extinguished, confirming the fortune-teller's words.

sentences.zh: 初，冽兄弟在父艱，廬於墓側，植松柏千余株，又同時榮貴，人推其友愛。

translations.literal: Earlier, when the Lie brothers were in mourning for their father, they built huts beside the tomb and planted more than a thousand pine and cypress trees; they also rose to eminence at the same time, and people praised their fraternal affection.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when the Lie brothers were in mourning for their father, they built huts beside the tomb and planted more than a thousand pine and cypress trees; they also rose to eminence at the same time, and people praised their fraternal affection.

sentences.zh: 冽子鏈，渙子銖，亦進士舉。

translations.literal: Lie's son Lian and Huan's son Zhu also passed the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: Lie's son Lian and Huan's son Zhu also passed the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 田仁會，雍州長安人。

translations.literal: Tian Renhui was a native of Chang'an in Yongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Renhui was a native of Chang'an in Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: 祖軌，隋幽州刺史、信都郡公。

translations.literal: His grandfather Gui was prefect of Youzhou under the Sui and Duke of Xindu Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Gui was prefect of Youzhou under the Sui and Duke of Xindu Commandery.

sentences.zh: 父弘，陵州刺史，襲信都郡公。

translations.literal: His father Hong was prefect of Lingzhou and inherited the title Duke of Xindu Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: His father Hong was prefect of Lingzhou and inherited the title Duke of Xindu Commandery.

sentences.zh: 仁會，武德初應制舉，授左衛兵曹，累遷左武候中郎將。

translations.literal: Renhui, in the early Wude era passed the special examination and was appointed military registrar of the Left Guard; after successive promotions he became commandant of the Left Military Court.
translations.idiomatic: Renhui, in the early Wude era passed the special examination and was appointed military registrar of the Left Guard; after successive promotions he became commandant of the Left Military Court.

sentences.zh: 貞觀十八年，太宗征遼發後，薛延陀數萬騎抄河南，太宗令仁會及執失思力率兵擊破之，逐北數百里，延陀脫身走免。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year of Zhenguan, after Emperor Taizong launched his Liaodong campaign, Xue Yantuo sent tens of thousands of cavalry to raid south of the Yellow River; Taizong ordered Renhui and Ashina Simosi to lead troops and defeat them, pursuing north for several hundred li until Yantuo barely escaped.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year of Zhenguan, after Emperor Taizong launched his Liaodong campaign, Xue Yantuo sent tens of thousands of cavalry to raid south of the Yellow River; Taizong ordered Renhui and Ashina Simosi to lead troops and defeat them, pursuing north for several hundred li until Yantuo barely escaped.

sentences.zh: 太宗嘉其功，降璽書慰勞。

translations.literal: Taizong commended his achievement and sent an imperial letter of commendation and consolation.
translations.idiomatic: Taizong commended his achievement and sent an imperial letter of commendation and consolation.

sentences.zh: 永徽二年，授平州刺史，勸學務農，稱為善政。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yonghui he was appointed prefect of Pingzhou; he encouraged learning and promoted agriculture, and his administration was praised as good governance.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Yonghui he was appointed prefect of Pingzhou; he encouraged learning and promoted agriculture, and his administration was praised as good governance.

sentences.zh: 轉郢州刺史，屬時旱，仁會自曝祈禱，竟獲甘澤。

translations.literal: He was transferred to prefect of Ezhou; at the time there was drought, and Renhui exposed himself to the sun in prayer, eventually receiving timely rain.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to prefect of Ezhou; at the time there was drought, and Renhui exposed himself to the sun in prayer, eventually receiving timely rain.

sentences.zh: 其年大熟，百姓歌曰：「父母育我田使君，精誠為人上天聞。

translations.literal: That year brought a great harvest, and the common people sang: "Our parents raised us, but Prefect Tian nourishes us; his sincere devotion on behalf of the people has been heard by Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: That year brought a great harvest, and the common people sang, "Our parents raised us, but Prefect Tian nourishes us; his sincere devotion on behalf of the people has been heard by Heaven.

sentences.zh: 田中致雨山出雲，倉廩既實禮義申。

translations.literal: In the fields he brought rain, from the mountains clouds arose; the granaries are full and ritual and righteousness flourish.
translations.idiomatic: In the fields he brought rain, from the mountains clouds arose; the granaries are full and ritual and righteousness flourish.

sentences.zh: 但願常在不患貧。

translations.literal: We only wish he may always remain, and we need not fear poverty.
translations.idiomatic: We only wish he may always remain, and we need not fear poverty.

sentences.zh: 」五遷勝州都督。

translations.literal: " After five promotions he became area commander of Shengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: " After five promotions he became area commander of Shengzhou.

sentences.zh: 州界有山賊阻險，劫奪行李，仁會發騎盡捕殺之。

translations.literal: Within the command's territory were mountain bandits blocking the passes and robbing travelers; Renhui dispatched cavalry and captured and killed them all.
translations.idiomatic: Within the command's territory were mountain bandits blocking the passes and robbing travelers; Renhui dispatched cavalry and captured and killed them all.

sentences.zh: 自是外戶不閉，盜賊絕跡。

translations.literal: From then on outer gates were left unlatched, and bandits vanished without a trace.
translations.idiomatic: From then on outer gates were left unlatched, and bandits vanished without a trace.

sentences.zh: 入為太府少卿。

translations.literal: He entered the capital as Vice Director of the Imperial Storehouse.
translations.idiomatic: He entered the capital as Vice Director of the Imperial Storehouse.

sentences.zh: 麟德二年，轉右金吾將軍，所得祿俸，估外有余，輒以納官，時人頗譏其邀名。

translations.literal: In the second year of Linde he was transferred to Right General of the Golden Phoenix Guard; whenever his salary and stipend exceeded the assessed amount, he immediately surrendered the surplus to the state treasury, and people of the time often mocked him for courting reputation.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Linde he was transferred to Right General of the Golden Phoenix Guard; whenever his salary and stipend exceeded the assessed amount, he immediately surrendered the surplus to the state treasury, and people of the time often mocked him for courting reputation.

sentences.zh: 仁會強力疾惡，晝夜巡警，自宮城至於衢路，絲毫越法，無不立發。

translations.literal: Renhui was forceful and hated evil; he patrolled day and night from the palace city to the public roads, and the slightest violation of the law was immediately exposed.
translations.idiomatic: Renhui was forceful and hated evil; he patrolled day and night from the palace city to the public roads, and the slightest violation of the law was immediately exposed.

sentences.zh: 每日庭引百余人，躬自閱罰，略無寬者。

translations.literal: Each day he summoned more than a hundred persons to court, personally reviewed and punished them, and showed scarcely any leniency.
translations.idiomatic: Each day he summoned more than a hundred persons to court, personally reviewed and punished them, and showed scarcely any leniency.

sentences.zh: 京城貴賤，鹹畏憚之。

translations.literal: Throughout the capital, high and low alike feared and respected him.
translations.idiomatic: Throughout the capital, high and low alike feared and respected him.

sentences.zh: 時有女巫蔡氏，以鬼道惑眾，自雲能令死者復生，市裏以為神明，仁會驗其假妄，奏請徙邊。

translations.literal: At the time there was a shamaness named Cai who used spirit worship to deceive the masses, claiming she could make the dead live again; the marketplace regarded her as a deity. Renhui verified her fraud and memorialized requesting her exile to the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: At the time there was a shamaness named Cai who used spirit worship to deceive the masses, claiming she could make the dead live again; the marketplace regarded her as a deity. Renhui verified her fraud and memorialized requesting her exile to the frontier.

sentences.zh: 高宗曰：「若死者不活，便是妖妄；

translations.literal: Emperor Gaozong said: "If the dead do not live again, that proves her sorcery and fraud;
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Gaozong said, "If the dead do not live again, that proves her sorcery and fraud;

sentences.zh: 若死者得生，更是罪過。

translations.literal: if the dead do live again, that is an even greater offense.
translations.idiomatic: if the dead do live again, that is an even greater offense.

sentences.zh: 」竟依仁會所奏。

translations.literal: " In the end he followed Renhui's memorial.
translations.idiomatic: " In the end he followed Renhui's memorial.

sentences.zh: 仁會，總章二年遷太常正卿，咸亨初又轉右衛將軍，以年老致仕。

translations.literal: Renhui, in the second year of Zongzhang was transferred to Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices; in the early Xianheng era he was again transferred to Right Guard General, and retired due to old age.
translations.idiomatic: Renhui, in the second year of Zongzhang was transferred to Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices; in the early Xianheng era he was again transferred to Right Guard General, and retired due to old age.

sentences.zh: 儀鳳四年卒，年七十八，謚曰威。

translations.literal: He died in the fourth year of Yifeng, at the age of seventy-eight; his posthumous title was Wei.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the fourth year of Yifeng, at the age of seventy-eight; his posthumous title was Wei.

sentences.zh: 神龍中，以子歸道贈戶部尚書。

translations.literal: During the Shenlong era, through his son Guidao he was posthumously granted the title of Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: During the Shenlong era, through his son Guidao he was posthumously granted the title of Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 歸道，弱冠明經舉。

translations.literal: Guidao, in young adulthood passed the classics examination.
translations.idiomatic: Guidao, in young adulthood passed the classics examination.

sentences.zh: 長壽中累補司賓丞，仍通事舍人內供奉。

translations.literal: During the Changshou era he was successively appointed Vice Director of the Court for Dependencies, while also serving as Palace Herald on internal assignment.
translations.idiomatic: During the Changshou era he was successively appointed Vice Director of the Court for Dependencies, while also serving as Palace Herald on internal assignment.

sentences.zh: 久之，轉左衛郎將。

translations.literal: After some time he was transferred to Colonel of the Left Guard.
translations.idiomatic: After some time he was transferred to Colonel of the Left Guard.

sentences.zh: 聖歷初，突厥默啜遣使請和，制遣左豹韜衛將軍閻知微入蕃，冊為立功報國可汗。

translations.literal: In the early Shengli era, the Turk chieftain Ashina Mochuo sent envoys requesting peace; by imperial decree the Left Leopard-Ta Guard General Yan Zhiwei was dispatched into the tribes to invest him as Khan Who Establishes Merit and Serves the State.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Shengli era, the Turk chieftain Ashina Mochuo sent envoys requesting peace; by imperial decree the Left Leopard-Ta Guard General Yan Zhiwei was dispatched into the tribes to invest him as Khan Who Establishes Merit and Serves the State.

sentences.zh: 默啜又遣使入朝謝恩，知微遇諸途，便與之緋袍、銀帶，兼表請蕃使入都日，大備陳設。

translations.literal: Mochuo again sent envoys to court to thank the emperor; Zhiwei encountered them on the road and gave them scarlet robes and silver belts, and also submitted a memorial requesting that when the tribal envoys entered the capital, elaborate arrangements be prepared.
translations.idiomatic: Mochuo again sent envoys to court to thank the emperor; Zhiwei encountered them on the road and gave them scarlet robes and silver belts, and also submitted a memorial requesting that when the tribal envoys entered the capital, elaborate arrangements be prepared.

sentences.zh: 歸道上言曰：「突厥背恩積稔，悔過來朝，宜待聖恩，寬其罪戾，解辮削衽，須稟天慈。

translations.literal: Guidao submitted a memorial saying: "The Turks have broken faith over many years; now that they repent and come to court, they should await the sage emperor's grace to pardon their crimes—unbraiding their hair and cutting their robes must await Heaven's compassion.
translations.idiomatic: Guidao submitted a memorial saying, "The Turks have broken faith over many years; now that they repent and come to court, they should await the sage emperor's grace to pardon their crimes—unbraiding their hair and cutting their robes must await Heaven's compassion.

sentences.zh: 知微擅與袍帶，國家更將何物充賜？

translations.literal: Zhiwei on his own authority gave robes and belts—what else will the state have left to bestow as gifts?
translations.idiomatic: Zhiwei on his own authority gave robes and belts—what else will the state have left to bestow as gifts?

sentences.zh: 望反初服，以俟朝恩。

translations.literal: I hope they may revert to their original dress and await the court's favor.
translations.idiomatic: I hope they may revert to their original dress and await the court's favor.

sentences.zh: 且小蕃使到，不勞大備之儀。

translations.literal: Moreover, a minor tribal envoy's arrival does not require elaborate ceremonial preparations.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, a minor tribal envoy's arrival does not require elaborate ceremonial preparations.

sentences.zh: 」則天然之。

translations.literal: " Empress Zetian approved this.
translations.idiomatic: " Empress Zetian approved this.

sentences.zh: 及默啜將至單於都護府，乃令歸道攝司賓卿迎勞之。

translations.literal: When Mochuo was about to reach the Protectorate General of the Chanyu, Guidao was ordered to serve as acting Director of the Court for Dependencies to welcome and honor him.
translations.idiomatic: When Mochuo was about to reach the Protectorate General of the Chanyu, Guidao was ordered to serve as acting Director of the Court for Dependencies to welcome and honor him.

sentences.zh: 默啜又奏請六胡州及單於都護府之地，則天不許。

translations.literal: Mochuo also memorialized requesting the territory of the Six Hu Prefectures and the Protectorate General of the Chanyu; Empress Zetian did not agree.
translations.idiomatic: Mochuo also memorialized requesting the territory of the Six Hu Prefectures and the Protectorate General of the Chanyu; Empress Zetian did not agree.

sentences.zh: 默啜深怨，遂拘縶歸道，將害之。

translations.literal: Mochuo bore deep resentment and had Guidao imprisoned, intending to kill him.
translations.idiomatic: Mochuo bore deep resentment and had Guidao imprisoned, intending to kill him.

sentences.zh: 歸道辭色不撓，更責以無厭求請，兼喻其禍福，默啜意稍解。

translations.literal: Guidao's words and bearing did not waver; he further rebuked him for insatiable requests and explained to him the fortunes and misfortunes—Mochuo's hostility gradually eased.
translations.idiomatic: Guidao's words and bearing did not waver; he further rebuked him for insatiable requests and explained to him the fortunes and misfortunes—Mochuo's hostility gradually eased.

sentences.zh: 會有制賜默啜粟三萬石、雜彩五萬段、農器三千事，並許之結婚。

translations.literal: Just then there was an imperial decree granting Mochuo thirty thousand shi of grain, fifty thousand bolts of patterned silk, three thousand agricultural implements, and permission for a marriage alliance.
translations.idiomatic: Just then there was an imperial decree granting Mochuo thirty thousand shi of grain, fifty thousand bolts of patterned silk, three thousand agricultural implements, and permission for a marriage alliance.

sentences.zh: 於是歸道得還，遂面陳默啜不利之狀，請加防禦，則天納焉。

translations.literal: Thereupon Guidao was able to return; he then presented in person Mochuo's dangerous condition and requested strengthened defenses, and Empress Zetian accepted his advice.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Guidao was able to return; he then presented in person Mochuo's dangerous condition and requested strengthened defenses, and Empress Zetian accepted his advice.

sentences.zh: 頃之，默啜果叛，挾閻知微入寇趙、定等州。

translations.literal: Before long Mochuo did indeed rebel, bringing Yan Zhiwei with him to invade the prefectures of Zhao, Ding, and others.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Mochuo did indeed rebel, bringing Yan Zhiwei with him to invade the prefectures of Zhao, Ding, and others.

sentences.zh: 擢拜歸道夏官侍郎，甚見親委。

translations.literal: Guidao was promoted and appointed Vice Minister of the Ministry of War, and received great trust and delegation.
translations.idiomatic: Guidao was promoted and appointed Vice Minister of the Ministry of War, and received great trust and delegation.

sentences.zh: 累遷左金吾將軍、司膳卿，兼押千騎。

translations.literal: After successive promotions he became Left General of the Golden Phoenix Guard and Director of Food Service, concurrently commanding the Thousand Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: After successive promotions he became Left General of the Golden Phoenix Guard and Director of Food Service, concurrently commanding the Thousand Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 未幾，除尚方監，加銀青光祿大夫。

translations.literal: Before long he was appointed Superintendent of Palace Manufactories and granted the title of Silver-Green Glory Grand Master.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was appointed Superintendent of Palace Manufactories and granted the title of Silver-Green Glory Grand Master.

sentences.zh: 轉殿中監，仍令依舊押千騎，宿衛於玄武門。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Superintendent of the Palace Department, still commanded the Thousand Cavalry as before, and stood guard at the Xuanwu Gate.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Superintendent of the Palace Department, still commanded the Thousand Cavalry as before, and stood guard at the Xuanwu Gate.

sentences.zh: 敬暉等討張易之、昌宗也，遣使就索千騎。

translations.literal: When Jing Hui and others were suppressing Zhang Yizhi and Zhang Changzong, they sent messengers to demand the Thousand Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: When Jing Hui and others were suppressing Zhang Yizhi and Zhang Changzong, they sent messengers to demand the Thousand Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 歸道既先不預謀，拒而不與。

translations.literal: Guidao had not been party to the plot beforehand and refused to surrender them.
translations.idiomatic: Guidao had not been party to the plot beforehand and refused to surrender them.

sentences.zh: 及事定，暉等將誅之，歸道執辭免，令歸私第。

translations.literal: When the affair was settled, Hui and the others were about to execute him, but Guidao argued his case and was spared, ordered to return to his private residence.
translations.idiomatic: When the affair was settled, Hui and the others were about to execute him, but Guidao argued his case and was spared, ordered to return to his private residence.

sentences.zh: 中宗嘉其忠壯，召拜太仆少卿，驟除殿中少監、右金吾將軍。

translations.literal: Emperor Zhongzong commended his loyalty and fortitude, summoned and appointed him Vice Director of the Imperial Stud, and swiftly made him Vice Superintendent of the Palace Department and Right General of the Golden Phoenix Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Zhongzong commended his loyalty and fortitude, summoned and appointed him Vice Director of the Imperial Stud, and swiftly made him Vice Superintendent of the Palace Department and Right General of the Golden Phoenix Guard.

sentences.zh: 歲余病卒，贈輔國大將軍，追封原國公，中宗親為文以祭之。

translations.literal: More than a year later he died of illness; he was posthumously granted the title of Grand General Who Supports the State, posthumously enfeoffed as Duke of Yuan, and Emperor Zhongzong personally composed a text to sacrifice to him.
translations.idiomatic: More than a year later he died of illness; he was posthumously granted the title of Grand General Who Supports the State, posthumously enfeoffed as Duke of Yuan, and Emperor Zhongzong personally composed a text to sacrifice to him.

sentences.zh: 子賓庭，開元中為光祿卿。

translations.literal: His son Binting, during the Kaiyuan era, served as Director of the Imperial Household.
translations.idiomatic: His son Binting, during the Kaiyuan era, served as Director of the Imperial Household.

sentences.zh: 韋機，雍州萬年人。

translations.literal: Wei Ji was a native of Wannian in Yongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Ji was a native of Wannian in Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: 祖元禮，隋浙州刺史。

translations.literal: His grandfather Yuanli was prefect of Zhe under the Sui.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Yuanli was prefect of Zhe under the Sui.

sentences.zh: 父恪，洛州別駕。

translations.literal: His father Ke was assistant prefect of Luozhou.
translations.idiomatic: His father Ke was assistant prefect of Luozhou.

sentences.zh: 機，貞觀中為左千牛胄曹，充使往西突厥，冊立同俄設為可汗。

translations.literal: Ji, during the Zhenguan era served as armorer clerk of the Left Palace Escort and was dispatched as envoy to the Western Turks, investing Tong'e She as khan.
translations.idiomatic: Ji, during the Zhenguan era served as armorer clerk of the Left Palace Escort and was dispatched as envoy to the Western Turks, investing Tong'e She as khan.

sentences.zh: 會石國反叛，路絕，三年不得歸。

translations.literal: When the state of Shiguo rebelled and the route was cut off, for three years he could not return.
translations.idiomatic: When the state of Shiguo rebelled and the route was cut off, for three years he could not return.

sentences.zh: 機裂裳錄所經諸國風俗物產，名為《西征記》。

translations.literal: Ji tore his garments and recorded the customs and products of the various countries he passed through, calling it Record of the Western Expedition.
translations.idiomatic: Ji tore his garments and recorded the customs and products of the various countries he passed through, calling it Record of the Western Expedition.

sentences.zh: 及還，太宗問蕃中事，機因奏所撰書。

translations.literal: Upon his return Emperor Taizong inquired about matters in the tribes, and Ji thereupon presented the work he had compiled.
translations.idiomatic: Upon his return Emperor Taizong inquired about matters in the tribes, and Ji thereupon presented the work he had compiled.

sentences.zh: 太宗大悅，擢拜朝散大夫，累遷至殿中監。

translations.literal: Taizong was greatly pleased and promoted him to Gentleman for Promoting Morals; after successive promotions he reached Superintendent of the Palace Department.
translations.idiomatic: Taizong was greatly pleased and promoted him to Gentleman for Promoting Morals; after successive promotions he reached Superintendent of the Palace Department.

sentences.zh: 顯慶中為檀州刺史。

translations.literal: During the Xianqing era he served as prefect of Tanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: During the Xianqing era he served as prefect of Tanzhou.

sentences.zh: 邊州素無學校，機敦勸生徒，創立孔子廟，圖七十二子及自古賢達，皆為之贊述。

translations.literal: The frontier commands had never had schools; Ji earnestly encouraged students, established a Confucian temple, and painted the Seventy-Two Disciples and sages of antiquity, composing encomia for each.
translations.idiomatic: The frontier commands had never had schools; Ji earnestly encouraged students, established a Confucian temple, and painted the Seventy-Two Disciples and sages of antiquity, composing encomia for each.

sentences.zh: 會契苾何力東討高麗，軍眾至檀州，而灤河泛漲，師不能進，供其資糧，數日不乏。

translations.literal: When Qieli Heli marched east to attack Goguryeo and his army reached Tanzhou, the Luan River flooded and the troops could not advance; Ji supplied their provisions and for several days they did not lack.
translations.idiomatic: When Qieli Heli marched east to attack Goguryeo and his army reached Tanzhou, the Luan River flooded and the troops could not advance; Ji supplied their provisions and for several days they did not lack.

sentences.zh: 何力全師還，以其事聞。

translations.literal: Heli returned with his entire force and reported the matter.
translations.idiomatic: Heli returned with his entire force and reported the matter.

sentences.zh: 高宗以為能，超拜司農少卿，兼知東都營田，甚見委遇。

translations.literal: Emperor Gaozong considered him capable, bypassed normal promotion and appointed him Vice Minister of the National Granaries, concurrently supervising Eastern Capital agricultural colonies, and greatly entrusted him.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Gaozong considered him capable, bypassed normal promotion and appointed him Vice Minister of the National Granaries, concurrently supervising Eastern Capital agricultural colonies, and greatly entrusted him.

sentences.zh: 有宦者於苑中犯法，機杖而後奏。

translations.literal: There was a eunuch who violated the law in the imperial park; Ji caned him and then reported afterward.
translations.idiomatic: There was a eunuch who violated the law in the imperial park; Ji caned him and then reported afterward.

sentences.zh: 高宗嗟賞，賜絹數十疋，謂曰：「更有犯者，卿即鞭之，不煩奏也。」

translations.literal: Gaozong sighed in admiration and gave him several tens of bolts of silk, saying: "If anyone else offends, you may whip them directly—there is no need to report."
translations.idiomatic: Gaozong sighed in admiration and gave him several tens of bolts of silk, saying, "If anyone else offends, you may whip them directly—there is no need to report."

sentences.zh: 上元中，遷司農卿，檢校園苑。

translations.literal: During the Shangyuan era he was transferred to Minister of the National Granaries and supervised the imperial parks and gardens.
translations.idiomatic: During the Shangyuan era he was transferred to Minister of the National Granaries and supervised the imperial parks and gardens.

sentences.zh: 造上陽宮，並移中橋從立德坊曲徙於長夏門街，時人稱其省功便事。

translations.literal: He built the Shangyang Palace and also moved the Central Bridge from the bend at Jide Ward to Changxia Gate Street—people of the time praised him for saving labor and convenience.
translations.idiomatic: He built the Shangyang Palace and also moved the Central Bridge from the bend at Jide Ward to Changxia Gate Street—people of the time praised him for saving labor and convenience.

sentences.zh: 有道士硃欽遂為天後所使，馳傳至都，所為橫恣。

translations.literal: There was a Daoist named Zhu Qinsui whom Empress Tianshou had dispatched; he arrived at the capital by imperial courier and behaved with arrogant license.
translations.idiomatic: There was a Daoist named Zhu Qinsui whom Empress Tianshou had dispatched; he arrived at the capital by imperial courier and behaved with arrogant license.

sentences.zh: 機囚之，因密奏曰：「道士假稱中宮驅使，依倚形勢，臣恐虧損皇明，為禍患之漸。

translations.literal: Ji imprisoned him and submitted a secret memorial saying: "This Daoist falsely claims to act on behalf of the inner palace, relying on his position—I fear this will tarnish the imperial brightness and become the beginning of calamity.
translations.idiomatic: Ji imprisoned him and submitted a secret memorial saying, "This Daoist falsely claims to act on behalf of the inner palace, relying on his position—I fear this will tarnish the imperial brightness and become the beginning of calamity.

sentences.zh: 」高宗特發中使慰諭機，而欽遂配流邊州，天後由是不悅。

translations.literal: " Gaozong specially dispatched a palace envoy to comfort and reassure Ji, while Qinsui was exiled to a frontier command; Empress Tianshou was displeased thereby.
translations.idiomatic: " Gaozong specially dispatched a palace envoy to comfort and reassure Ji, while Qinsui was exiled to a frontier command; Empress Tianshou was displeased thereby.

sentences.zh: 儀鳳中，機坐家人犯盜，為憲司所劾，免官。

translations.literal: During the Yifeng era Ji was implicated because a family member committed theft and was impeached by the censorate, and was dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yifeng era Ji was implicated because a family member committed theft and was impeached by the censorate, and was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 永淳中，高宗幸東都，至芳桂宮驛，召機，令白衣檢校園苑。

translations.literal: During the Yongchun era Emperor Gaozong journeyed to the Eastern Capital; when he reached Fanggui Palace Post Station he summoned Ji and ordered him to serve in plain clothes supervising the parks and gardens.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yongchun era Emperor Gaozong journeyed to the Eastern Capital; when he reached Fanggui Palace Post Station he summoned Ji and ordered him to serve in plain clothes supervising the parks and gardens.

sentences.zh: 將復本官，為天後所擠而止，俄令檢校司農少卿事，會卒。

translations.literal: He was about to be restored to his original office but was blocked by Empress Tianshou; soon afterward he was ordered to serve as acting Vice Minister of the National Granaries, and then died.
translations.idiomatic: He was about to be restored to his original office but was blocked by Empress Tianshou; soon afterward he was ordered to serve as acting Vice Minister of the National Granaries, and then died.

sentences.zh: 子余慶。

translations.literal: His son was Yuqing.
translations.idiomatic: His son was Yuqing.

sentences.zh: 余慶官至右驍衛兵曹，早卒。

translations.literal: Yuqing reached the post of military registrar of the Right Tiger Guard Cavalry and died young.
translations.idiomatic: Yuqing reached the post of military registrar of the Right Tiger Guard Cavalry and died young.

sentences.zh: 余慶子嶽。

translations.literal: Yuqing's son was Yue.
translations.idiomatic: Yuqing's son was Yue.

sentences.zh: 嶽亦以吏幹著名，則天時，累轉汝州司馬。

translations.literal: Yue was also known for his administrative competence; during Empress Zetian's reign he was successively transferred to military registrar of Ruzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yue was also known for his administrative competence; during Empress Zetian's reign he was successively transferred to military registrar of Ruzhou.

sentences.zh: 會則天幸長安，召拜尚舍奉禦，從駕還京，因召見。

translations.literal: When Empress Zetian visited Chang'an, he was summoned and appointed Palace Housing Attendant; he followed the imperial carriage back to the capital and was granted an audience.
translations.idiomatic: When Empress Zetian visited Chang'an, he was summoned and appointed Palace Housing Attendant; he followed the imperial carriage back to the capital and was granted an audience.

sentences.zh: 則天謂曰：「卿是韋機之孫，勤幹固有家風也。

translations.literal: Empress Zetian said: "You are Wei Ji's grandson—diligence and competence run in your family.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Zetian said, "You are Wei Ji's grandson—diligence and competence run in your family.

sentences.zh: 卿之家事，朕悉知之。

translations.literal: As for your family's affairs, I know them all.
translations.idiomatic: As for your family's affairs, I know them all.

sentences.zh: 」因問家人名，賞慰良久。

translations.literal: " She then asked the names of his family members and rewarded and comforted him at length.
translations.idiomatic: " She then asked the names of his family members and rewarded and comforted him at length.

sentences.zh: 尋拜太原尹。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was appointed governor of Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was appointed governor of Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 嶽素不習武，固辭邊任。

translations.literal: Yue had never practiced martial arts and firmly declined the frontier post.
translations.idiomatic: Yue had never practiced martial arts and firmly declined the frontier post.

sentences.zh: 由是忤旨，左遷宋州長史，歷海、虢二州刺史，所在皆著威名。

translations.literal: For this he offended the imperial will and was demoted to chief administrator of Songzhou; he served as prefect of Hai and Guo, and wherever he served he earned a reputation for authority.
translations.idiomatic: For this he offended the imperial will and was demoted to chief administrator of Songzhou; he served as prefect of Hai and Guo, and wherever he served he earned a reputation for authority.

sentences.zh: 睿宗時，入為殿中少監，甚承恩顧。

translations.literal: During the Ruizong era he entered the capital as Vice Superintendent of the Palace Department and received great favor.
translations.idiomatic: During the Ruizong era he entered the capital as Vice Superintendent of the Palace Department and received great favor.

sentences.zh: 及竇懷貞、李晉等伏誅，以嶽嘗與交往，為姜皎所陷，左遷渠州別駕，稍遷陜州刺史。

translations.literal: When Dou Huaizhen, Li Jin, and others were executed, because Yue had once associated with them he was framed by Jiang Jiao, demoted to assistant prefect of Quzhou, and later transferred to prefect of Shanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When Dou Huaizhen, Li Jin, and others were executed, because Yue had once associated with them he was framed by Jiang Jiao, demoted to assistant prefect of Quzhou, and later transferred to prefect of Shanzhou.

sentences.zh: 開元中，卒於潁州別駕。

translations.literal: During the Kaiyuan era he died while serving as assistant prefect of Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: During the Kaiyuan era he died while serving as assistant prefect of Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 嶽子景駿。

translations.literal: Yue's son was Jingjun.
translations.idiomatic: Yue's son was Jingjun.

sentences.zh: 景駿明經舉，神龍中，累轉肥鄉令。

translations.literal: Jingjun passed the classics examination; during the Shenlong era he was successively transferred to magistrate of Feixiang.
translations.idiomatic: Jingjun passed the classics examination; during the Shenlong era he was successively transferred to magistrate of Feixiang.

sentences.zh: 縣北界漳水，連年泛溢。

translations.literal: The county's northern border was the Zhang River, which flooded year after year.
translations.idiomatic: The county's northern border was the Zhang River, which flooded year after year.

sentences.zh: 舊堤迫近水漕，雖修築不息，而漂流相繼。

translations.literal: The old dike was close to the water channel; though repairs never ceased, washouts followed one after another.
translations.idiomatic: The old dike was close to the water channel; though repairs never ceased, washouts followed one after another.

sentences.zh: 景駿審其地勢，拓南數里，因高築堤。

translations.literal: Jingjun studied the terrain, extended the dike several li to the south, and built it high.
translations.idiomatic: Jingjun studied the terrain, extended the dike several li to the south, and built it high.

sentences.zh: 暴水至，堤南以無患，水去而堤北稱為腴田。

translations.literal: When floodwaters came, the area south of the dike was unharmed; when the water receded the land north of the dike was praised as rich farmland.
translations.idiomatic: When floodwaters came, the area south of the dike was unharmed; when the water receded the land north of the dike was praised as rich farmland.

sentences.zh: 漳水舊有架柱長橋，每年修葺，景駿又改造為浮橋。

translations.literal: The Zhang River had long had a bridge with supporting pillars that required annual repairs; Jingjun rebuilt it as a pontoon bridge.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhang River had long had a bridge with supporting pillars that required annual repairs; Jingjun rebuilt it as a pontoon bridge.

sentences.zh: 自是無復水患，至今賴焉。

translations.literal: From then on there were no further flood disasters, and people still benefit from this today.
translations.idiomatic: From then on there were no further flood disasters, and people still benefit from this today.

sentences.zh: 時河北饑，景駿躬撫合境村閭，必通贍恤，貧弱獨免流離。

translations.literal: At the time Hebei suffered famine; Jingjun personally visited every village in the command to ensure full relief, and the poor and weak alone were spared displacement.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Hebei suffered famine; Jingjun personally visited every village in the command to ensure full relief, and the poor and weak alone were spared displacement.

sentences.zh: 及去任，人吏立碑頌德。

translations.literal: When he left his post, officials and commoners erected a stele praising his virtue.
translations.idiomatic: When he left his post, officials and commoners erected a stele praising his virtue.

sentences.zh: 開元中，為貴鄉令。

translations.literal: During the Kaiyuan era he served as magistrate of Guixiang.
translations.idiomatic: During the Kaiyuan era he served as magistrate of Guixiang.

sentences.zh: 縣人有母子相訟者，景駿謂之曰：「吾少孤，每見人養親，自恨終天無分，汝幸在溫清之地，何得如此？

translations.literal: There was a mother and son in the county suing each other; Jingjun said to them: "I was orphaned young; whenever I see others caring for their parents I regret that I had no such chance in this life. You are fortunate to be in a place of warmth and comfort—how can you act this way?
translations.idiomatic: There was a mother and son in the county suing each other; Jingjun said to them, "I was orphaned young; whenever I see others caring for their parents I regret that I had no such chance in this life. You are fortunate to be in a place of warmth and comfort—how can you act this way?

sentences.zh: 錫類不行，令之罪也。

translations.literal: When kindness among kindred is not practiced, it is the magistrate's fault.
translations.idiomatic: When kindness among kindred is not practiced, it is the magistrate's fault.

sentences.zh: 」因垂泣嗚咽，仍取《孝經》付令習讀之。

translations.literal: " He wept and sobbed, then gave them the Classic of Filial Piety and had the son study it.
translations.idiomatic: " He wept and sobbed, then gave them the Classic of Filial Piety and had the son study it.

sentences.zh: 於是母子感悟，各請改悔，遂稱慈孝。

translations.literal: Thereupon the mother and son were moved and each requested to repent; they thereafter were praised for filial piety.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the mother and son were moved and each requested to repent; they thereafter were praised for filial piety.

sentences.zh: 累轉趙州長史，路由肥鄉，人吏驚喜，競來犒餞，留連經日。

translations.literal: After successive promotions he became chief administrator of Zhaozhou; passing through Feixiang, officials and commoners were delighted and competed to offer farewell gifts, staying for several days.
translations.idiomatic: After successive promotions he became chief administrator of Zhaozhou; passing through Feixiang, officials and commoners were delighted and competed to offer farewell gifts, staying for several days.

sentences.zh: 有童稚數人，年甫十余歲，亦在其中，景駿謂曰：「計吾為此令時，汝輩未生，既無舊恩，何殷勤之甚也？

translations.literal: There were several children barely over ten who were among them; Jingjun said: "When I think that I was magistrate here, you were not yet born—since you have no old debt of kindness, why are you so warm in your attentions?
translations.idiomatic: There were several children barely over ten who were among them; Jingjun said, "When I think that I was magistrate here, you were not yet born—since you have no old debt of kindness, why are you so warm in your attentions?

sentences.zh: 」鹹對曰：「此間長宿傳說，縣中廨宇、學堂、館舍、堤橋，並是明公遺跡。

translations.literal: " They all replied: "The elders here tell us that the county offices, school, hostel, dike, and bridge are all your honored legacy.
translations.idiomatic: " They all replied, "The elders here tell us that the county offices, school, hostel, dike, and bridge are all your honored legacy.

sentences.zh: 將謂古人，不意親得瞻睹，不覺欣戀倍於常也。

translations.literal: We took you for an ancient figure and did not expect to see you in person—our joy and longing are twice the ordinary."
translations.idiomatic: We took you for an ancient figure and did not expect to see you in person—our joy and longing are twice the ordinary."

sentences.zh: 」其為人所思如此。

translations.literal: Such was the way he was remembered by the people.
translations.idiomatic: Such was the way he was remembered by the people.

sentences.zh: 十七年，遷房州刺史。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he was transferred to prefect of Fangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he was transferred to prefect of Fangzhou.

sentences.zh: 州帶山谷，俗參蠻夷，好淫祀而不修學校。

translations.literal: The prefecture bordered mountains and valleys; the people were mixed with barbarians, fond of excessive sacrifices and not maintaining schools.
translations.idiomatic: The prefecture bordered mountains and valleys; the people were mixed with barbarians, fond of excessive sacrifices and not maintaining schools.

sentences.zh: 景駿始開貢舉，悉除淫祀。

translations.literal: Jingjun first opened recruitment examinations and abolished all improper sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Jingjun first opened recruitment examinations and abolished all improper sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 又通狹路，並造傳館，行旅甚以為便。

translations.literal: He also opened narrow passes and built relay stations; travelers found this very convenient.
translations.idiomatic: He also opened narrow passes and built relay stations; travelers found this very convenient.

sentences.zh: 二十年，轉奉先令，未行而卒。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he was transferred to magistrate of Fengxian but died before departing.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year he was transferred to magistrate of Fengxian but died before departing.

sentences.zh: 權懷恩，雍州萬年人，周荊州刺史、千金郡公景宣玄孫也。

translations.literal: Quan Huai'en was a native of Wannian in Yongzhou, a fourth-generation descendant of Quan Jingxuan, Zhou prefect of Jingzhou and Duke of Qianjin Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Quan Huai'en was a native of Wannian in Yongzhou, a fourth-generation descendant of Quan Jingxuan, Zhou prefect of Jingzhou and Duke of Qianjin Commandery.

sentences.zh: 其先自天水徙家焉。

translations.literal: His ancestors had moved their household there from Tianshui.
translations.idiomatic: His ancestors had moved their household there from Tianshui.

sentences.zh: 祖弘壽，大業末為臨汾郡司倉書佐。

translations.literal: His grandfather Hongshou, at the end of the Daye era served as granary clerk of Linfen Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Hongshou, at the end of the Daye era served as granary clerk of Linfen Commandery.

sentences.zh: 高祖鎮晉陽，引判留守事。

translations.literal: When Gaozu held Jin-yang, he was brought in to assist in matters of the regent's office.
translations.idiomatic: When Gaozu held Jin-yang, he was brought in to assist in matters of the regent's office.

sentences.zh: 以從義師之功，累轉秦王府長史，太宗遇之甚厚。

translations.literal: For merit in following the righteous army he was successively promoted to chief secretary of the Prince of Qin's household; Taizong treated him very generously.
translations.idiomatic: For merit in following the righteous army he was successively promoted to chief secretary of the Prince of Qin's household; Taizong treated him very generously.

sentences.zh: 又從平王世充，拜太仆卿。

translations.literal: He also followed in the pacification of Wang Shichong and was appointed Director of the Imperial Stud.
translations.idiomatic: He also followed in the pacification of Wang Shichong and was appointed Director of the Imperial Stud.

sentences.zh: 累封盧國公卒，謚曰恭。

translations.literal: After successive enfeoffments as Duke of Lu he died; his posthumous title was Gong.
translations.idiomatic: After successive enfeoffments as Duke of Lu he died; his posthumous title was Gong.

sentences.zh: 父知讓，襲爵，官至博州刺史。

translations.literal: His father Zhirang inherited the title and reached the post of prefect of Bozhou.
translations.idiomatic: His father Zhirang inherited the title and reached the post of prefect of Bozhou.

sentences.zh: 懷恩初以廕授太子洗馬。

translations.literal: Huai'en initially entered service through yin privilege as groom of the heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Huai'en initially entered service through yin privilege as groom of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 咸亨初，累轉尚乘奉禦，襲爵盧國公。

translations.literal: In the early Xianheng era he was successively transferred to Imperial Chariot Attendant and inherited the title Duke of Lu.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Xianheng era he was successively transferred to Imperial Chariot Attendant and inherited the title Duke of Lu.

sentences.zh: 時有奉乘安畢羅善於調馬，甚為高宗所寵。

translations.literal: At the time there was an imperial charioteer named An Biluo who was skilled at training horses and was greatly favored by Emperor Gaozong.
translations.idiomatic: At the time there was an imperial charioteer named An Biluo who was skilled at training horses and was greatly favored by Emperor Gaozong.

sentences.zh: 懷恩奏事，遇畢羅在帝左右戲無禮，懷恩退而杖之四十。

translations.literal: When Huai'en was reporting for duty he encountered Biluo playing disrespectfully beside the emperor; after withdrawing Huai'en caned him forty strokes.
translations.idiomatic: When Huai'en was reporting for duty he encountered Biluo playing disrespectfully beside the emperor; after withdrawing Huai'en caned him forty strokes.

sentences.zh: 高宗知而嗟賞之，謂侍臣曰：「懷恩乃能不避強禦，真良吏也。

translations.literal: Gaozong learned of this and sighed in admiration, telling his attending officials: "Huai'en was able not to avoid confronting the powerful—truly a good official.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozong learned of this and sighed in admiration, telling his attending officials, "Huai'en was able not to avoid confronting the powerful—truly a good official.

sentences.zh: 」即日拜萬年令。

translations.literal: " That same day he was appointed magistrate of Wannian.
translations.idiomatic: " That same day he was appointed magistrate of Wannian.

sentences.zh: 為政清肅，令行禁止，前後京縣令無及之者。

translations.literal: His governance was clear and stern; when he issued orders they were obeyed and when he forbade they ceased—none of the capital county magistrates before or after him could match him.
translations.idiomatic: His governance was clear and stern; when he issued orders they were obeyed and when he forbade they ceased—none of the capital county magistrates before or after him could match him.

sentences.zh: 後歷慶、萊、衛、邢四州刺史，洛州長史。

translations.literal: Later he served successively as prefect of Qing, Lai, Wei, and Xing, and as chief administrator of Luozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Later he served successively as prefect of Qing, Lai, Wei, and Xing, and as chief administrator of Luozhou.

sentences.zh: 懷恩姿狀雄毅，束帶之後，妻子不敢仰視。

translations.literal: Huai'en was imposing and resolute in bearing; after he dressed in official regalia, his wife and children dared not look up at him.
translations.idiomatic: Huai'en was imposing and resolute in bearing; after he dressed in official regalia, his wife and children dared not look up at him.

sentences.zh: 所歷皆以威名禦下，人吏重足而立。

translations.literal: Wherever he served he controlled subordinates through his reputation for authority; officials and clerks stood as if on piled feet.
translations.idiomatic: Wherever he served he controlled subordinates through his reputation for authority; officials and clerks stood in fearful stillness.

sentences.zh: 俄出為宋州刺史。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was sent out as prefect of Songzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was sent out as prefect of Songzhou.

sentences.zh: 時汴州刺史楊德幹亦以嚴肅與懷恩齊名。

translations.literal: At the time the Bianzhou prefect Yang Degan was also renowned for severity alongside Huai'en.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the Bianzhou prefect Yang Degan was also renowned for severity alongside Huai'en.

sentences.zh: 至是懷恩路由汴州，德幹送之出郊，懷恩見新橋中途立木以禁車過者，謂德幹曰：「一言處分豈不得，何用此為？

translations.literal: When Huai'en's route passed through Bianzhou, Degan saw him off beyond the suburbs; Huai'en saw that a new bridge had posts set midway to block carriages from passing and said to Degan: "A single word of disposition would suffice—why resort to this?
translations.idiomatic: When Huai'en's route passed through Bianzhou, Degan saw him off beyond the suburbs; Huai'en saw that a new bridge had posts set midway to block carriages from passing and said to Degan, "A single word of disposition would suffice—why resort to this?

sentences.zh: 」德幹大慚，時議以為不如懷恩也。

translations.literal: " Degan was greatly ashamed; public opinion held that he did not measure up to Huai'en.
translations.idiomatic: " Degan was greatly ashamed; public opinion held that he did not measure up to Huai'en.

sentences.zh: 轉益州大都督府長史，尋卒。

translations.literal: He was transferred to chief secretary of the Yizhou Area Command and soon died.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to chief secretary of the Yizhou Area Command and soon died.

sentences.zh: 侄楚璧，官至左領軍衛兵曹參軍。

translations.literal: His nephew Chubi reached the post of military registrar of the Left Vanguard Guard.
translations.idiomatic: His nephew Chubi reached the post of military registrar of the Left Vanguard Guard.

sentences.zh: 開元十年，駕在東都，楚璧乃與故兵部尚書李迥秀男齊損、從祖弟金吾淑、陳倉尉、盧玢及京城左屯營押官長上折沖周履濟、楊楚劍、元令琪等舉兵反。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Kaiyuan, when the emperor was at the Eastern Capital, Chubi together with Qi Sun, son of the former Minister of War Li Huiuxiu, his cousin Jinsu of the Golden Crow Guard, the Chencang magistrate Lu Bin, and the Left Vanguard Camp senior warrant officers Zhou Lvji, Yang Chujian, Yuan Lingqi, and others rose in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year of Kaiyuan, when the emperor was at the Eastern Capital, Chubi together with Qi Sun, son of the former Minister of War Li Huiuxiu, his cousin Jinsu of the Golden Crow Guard, the Chencang magistrate Lu Bin, and the Left Vanguard Camp senior warrant officers Zhou Lvji, Yang Chujian, Yuan Lingqi, and others rose in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 立楚璧兄子梁山，年十五，詐稱襄王男，號為光帝。

translations.literal: They installed Chubi's elder brother's son Liangshan, aged fifteen, falsely claiming he was a son of the Prince of Xiang, and titled him Emperor Guang.
translations.idiomatic: They installed Chubi's elder brother's son Liangshan, aged fifteen, falsely claiming he was a son of the Prince of Xiang, and titled him Emperor Guang.

sentences.zh: 擁左屯營兵百余人，梯上景風門，逾城而入，踞長樂恭禮門。

translations.literal: They mustered more than a hundred soldiers of the Left Vanguard Camp, scaled Jingfeng Gate with ladders, crossed the wall, and seized Changle Gongli Gate.
translations.idiomatic: They mustered more than a hundred soldiers of the Left Vanguard Camp, scaled Jingfeng Gate with ladders, crossed the wall, and seized Changle Gongli Gate.

sentences.zh: 入宮城，求留守、刑部尚書王誌愔，不獲。

translations.literal: Entering the palace city, they sought the regent and Minister of Punishments Wang Zhiken but did not find him.
translations.idiomatic: Entering the palace city, they sought the regent and Minister of Punishments Wang Zhiken but did not find him.

sentences.zh: 屬天曉，屯營兵自相翻覆，盡殺梁山等。

translations.literal: As dawn broke, the Vanguard Camp soldiers turned on one another and killed Liangshan and the others.
translations.idiomatic: As dawn broke, the Vanguard Camp soldiers turned on one another and killed Liangshan and the others.

sentences.zh: 傳首東都，楚璧並坐籍沒。

translations.literal: Their heads were sent to the Eastern Capital; Chubi and the others were implicated and their property confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: Their heads were sent to the Eastern Capital; Chubi and the others were implicated and their property confiscated.

sentences.zh: 懷恩叔祖萬紀。

translations.literal: Huai'en's grand-uncle was Wanji.
translations.idiomatic: Huai'en's grand-uncle was Wanji.

sentences.zh: 萬紀性強正，好直言。

translations.literal: Wanji was strong and upright and fond of speaking plainly.
translations.idiomatic: Wanji was strong and upright and fond of speaking plainly.

sentences.zh: 貞觀中，為治書侍御史，以公事奏劾魏征、溫彥博等，太宗以為不避豪貴，甚禮之。

translations.literal: During the Zhenguan era he served as attendant censor; for official matters he impeached Wei Zheng, Wen Yanbo, and others; Taizong considered that he did not avoid the powerful and noble and greatly honored him.
translations.idiomatic: During the Zhenguan era he served as attendant censor; for official matters he impeached Wei Zheng, Wen Yanbo, and others; Taizong considered that he did not avoid the powerful and noble and greatly honored him.

sentences.zh: 遷尚書左丞，封冀氏男，再轉齊王祐府長史。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Left Vice Director of the Secretariat, enfeoffed as Baron of Jishi, and again transferred to chief secretary of the Prince of Qi's household.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Left Vice Director of the Secretariat, enfeoffed as Baron of Jishi, and again transferred to chief secretary of the Prince of Qi's household.

sentences.zh: 祐既失德，數匡正之，竟為祐所殺，語在《祐傳》。

translations.literal: You had repeatedly lost moral standing and Wanji repeatedly corrected him, but in the end was killed by You—as told in the Biography of You.
translations.idiomatic: You had repeatedly lost moral standing and Wanji repeatedly corrected him, but in the end was killed by You—as told in the Biography of You.

sentences.zh: 祐既死，贈萬紀齊州都督、武都公，謚曰敬。

translations.literal: After You died, Wanji was posthumously granted the title of Area Commander of Qizhou and Duke of Wudu; his posthumous title was Jing.
translations.idiomatic: After You died, Wanji was posthumously granted the title of Area Commander of Qizhou and Duke of Wudu; his posthumous title was Jing.

sentences.zh: 子玄福，高宗時為兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: His son Xuanfu, during the Gaozong era, served as Vice Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: His son Xuanfu, during the Gaozong era, served as Vice Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 馮元常，相州安陽人，自長樂徙家焉，北齊右僕射子琮曾孫也。

translations.literal: Feng Yuanchang was a native of Anyang in Xiangzhou; his family had moved there from Changle; he was a great-grandson of Feng Zicong, Right Vice Director under Northern Qi.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Yuanchang was a native of Anyang in Xiangzhou; his family had moved there from Changle; he was a great-grandson of Feng Zicong, Right Vice Director under Northern Qi.

sentences.zh: 舉明經。

translations.literal: He passed the classics examination.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the classics examination.

sentences.zh: 高宗時，累遷監察御史，為劍南道巡察使，興利除害，蜀土賴焉。

translations.literal: During the Gaozong era he was successively transferred to investigating censor and served as inspection commissioner of the Jiannan Circuit, benefiting the people and removing harm; the Shu region relied upon him.
translations.idiomatic: During the Gaozong era he was successively transferred to investigating censor and served as inspection commissioner of the Jiannan Circuit, benefiting the people and removing harm; the Shu region relied upon him.

sentences.zh: 永淳中，為尚書左丞。

translations.literal: During the Yongchun era he served as Left Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yongchun era he served as Left Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 元常清鑒有理識，甚為高宗之所賞。

translations.literal: Yuanchang had clear insight and rational judgment and was greatly appreciated by Emperor Gaozong.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanchang had clear insight and rational judgment and was greatly appreciated by Emperor Gaozong.

sentences.zh: 嘗密奏「中宮權重，宜稍抑損」，高宗雖不能用，深以其言為然。

translations.literal: He once secretly memorialized that "the inner palace's power is weighty and should be slightly curtailed"; though Gaozong could not act on it, he deeply agreed with his words.
translations.idiomatic: He once secretly memorialized that "the inner palace's power is weighty and should be slightly curtailed"; though Gaozong could not act on it, he deeply agreed with his words.

sentences.zh: 則天聞而甚惡之。

translations.literal: Zetian learned of this and greatly hated him.
translations.idiomatic: Zetian learned of this and greatly hated him.

sentences.zh: 及臨朝，四方承旨，多獻符瑞。

translations.literal: When she assumed the throne, officials throughout the realm, following the tone from above, mostly presented auspicious omens.
translations.idiomatic: When she assumed the throne, officials throughout the realm, following the tone from above, mostly presented auspicious omens.

sentences.zh: 嵩陽令樊文進瑞石，則天命於朝堂示百官。

translations.literal: The Songyang magistrate Fan Wenjin presented an auspicious stone; Zetian ordered it displayed to the hundred officials in the court hall.
translations.idiomatic: The Songyang magistrate Fan Wenjin presented an auspicious stone; Zetian ordered it displayed to the hundred officials in the court hall.

sentences.zh: 元常奏言：「狀涉諂偽，不可誣罔士庶。

translations.literal: Yuanchang memorialized: "This matter smacks of flattery and fraud; the scholar-commoners must not be deceived.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanchang memorialized, "This matter smacks of flattery and fraud; the scholar-commoners must not be deceived.

sentences.zh: 」則天不悅，出為隴州刺史。

translations.literal: " Zetian was displeased and sent him out as prefect of Longzhou.
translations.idiomatic: " Zetian was displeased and sent him out as prefect of Longzhou.

sentences.zh: 俄而天下嶽牧集乾陵會葬，則天不欲元常赴陵所，中途改授眉州刺史。

translations.literal: Soon all the regional inspectors assembled at Qianling for the burial; Zetian did not want Yuanchang to go to the tomb site and midway reassigned him as prefect of Meizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Soon all the regional inspectors assembled at Qianling for the burial; Zetian did not want Yuanchang to go to the tomb site and midway reassigned him as prefect of Meizhou.

sentences.zh: 劍南先時光火賊夜掠居人，晝潛山谷。

translations.literal: In Jiannan there had earlier been bandits who raided households by night using fire and hid in mountain valleys by day.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiannan there had earlier been bandits who raided households by night using fire and hid in mountain valleys by day.

sentences.zh: 元常至，喻以恩信，許其首露，仍切加捕逐，賊徒舍器杖，面縛自陳者相繼。

translations.literal: When Yuanchang arrived he instructed them with kindness and trust, promised amnesty to those who confessed first, and also pressed the hunt; bandits one after another cast aside weapons and came forward bound to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuanchang arrived he instructed them with kindness and trust, promised amnesty to those who confessed first, and also pressed the hunt; bandits one after another cast aside weapons and came forward bound to surrender.

sentences.zh: 又轉廣州都督，便道之任，不許詣都。

translations.literal: He was again transferred to area commander of Guangzhou, going directly to his post without being permitted to visit the capital.
translations.idiomatic: He was again transferred to area commander of Guangzhou, going directly to his post without being permitted to visit the capital.

sentences.zh: 尋屬安南首領李嗣仙殺都護劉延祐，剽陷州縣，敕元常討之。

translations.literal: Soon the Annam chieftain Li Sixian killed the protector-general Liu Yanyou and plundered and seized prefectures and counties; Yuanchang was ordered to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the Annam chieftain Li Sixian killed the protector-general Liu Yanyou and plundered and seized prefectures and counties; Yuanchang was ordered to suppress him.

sentences.zh: 率士卒濟南海，先馳檄示以威恩，喻以禍福。

translations.literal: Leading troops across the South Sea, he first dispatched proclamations displaying authority and kindness, explaining fortunes and misfortunes.
translations.idiomatic: Leading troops across the South Sea, he first dispatched proclamations displaying authority and kindness, explaining fortunes and misfortunes.

sentences.zh: 嗣仙徒黨多相率歸降，因縱兵誅其魁首，安慰居人而旋。

translations.literal: Many of Sixian's followers successively surrendered; he then unleashed troops to execute the ringleaders, reassured the settled population, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Many of Sixian's followers successively surrendered; he then unleashed troops to execute the ringleaders, reassured the settled population, and returned.

sentences.zh: 雖屢有政績，則天竟不賞之。

translations.literal: Though he repeatedly achieved political merit, Zetian in the end did not reward him.
translations.idiomatic: Though he repeatedly achieved political merit, Zetian in the end did not reward him.

sentences.zh: 尋為酷吏周興所陷，追赴都，下獄死。

translations.literal: Soon he was framed by the cruel official Zhou Xing, summoned to the capital, thrown into prison, and died there.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was framed by the cruel official Zhou Xing, summoned to the capital, thrown into prison, and died there.

sentences.zh: 元常閨門雍肅，雅有禮度，雖小功之喪，未嘗寢於私室，甚為士類所稱。

translations.literal: Within Yuanchang's household harmony and solemnity prevailed; he had proper ritual decorum—even for mourning of the second descending degree he never slept in a private room, and the scholar class greatly praised this.
translations.idiomatic: Within Yuanchang's household harmony and solemnity prevailed; he had proper ritual decorum—even for mourning of the second descending degree he never slept in a private room, and the scholar class greatly praised this.

sentences.zh: 從父弟元淑，則天時為清漳令，政有殊績，百姓號為神明。

translations.literal: His cousin Yuanshu, during Zetian's reign, served as magistrate of Qingzhang; his administration had exceptional achievements and the common people called him a deity.
translations.idiomatic: His cousin Yuanshu, during Zetian's reign, served as magistrate of Qingzhang; his administration had exceptional achievements and the common people called him a deity.

sentences.zh: 又歷浚儀、始平二縣令，皆單騎赴職，未嘗以妻子之官。

translations.literal: He also served as magistrate of Junyi and Shaping; in each case he went to his post alone on horseback and never brought his wife and children to office.
translations.idiomatic: He also served as magistrate of Junyi and Shaping; in each case he went to his post alone on horseback and never brought his wife and children to office.

sentences.zh: 所乘馬，午後則不與芻，雲令其作齋。

translations.literal: The horse he rode was not given fodder after noon, as he said this made it observe the fast.
translations.idiomatic: The horse he rode was not given fodder after noon, as he said this made it observe the fast.

sentences.zh: 身及奴仆，每日一食而已。

translations.literal: He and his servants ate only one meal per day.
translations.idiomatic: He and his servants ate only one meal per day.

sentences.zh: 俸祿之余，皆供公用，並給與貧士。

translations.literal: Surplus from salary and stipend was all devoted to public use and given to poor scholars.
translations.idiomatic: Surplus from salary and stipend was all devoted to public use and given to poor scholars.

sentences.zh: 人或譏其邀名，元淑曰：「此吾本性，不為苦也。

translations.literal: When some mocked him for courting reputation, Yuanshu said: "This is my true nature—it is not hardship for me.
translations.idiomatic: When some mocked him for courting reputation, Yuanshu said, "This is my true nature—it is not hardship for me.

sentences.zh: 」中宗時，降璽書勞勉，仍令史官編其事跡。

translations.literal: " During the Zhongzong era an imperial letter of commendation was sent; he was also ordered to have the historiographers compile an account of his deeds.
translations.idiomatic: " During the Zhongzong era an imperial letter of commendation was sent; he was also ordered to have the historiographers compile an account of his deeds.

sentences.zh: 卒於祠部郎中。

translations.literal: He died while serving as Director of the Ministry of Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: He died while serving as Director of the Ministry of Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 蔣儼，常州義興人。

translations.literal: Jiang Yan was a native of Yixing in Changzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Yan was a native of Yixing in Changzhou.

sentences.zh: 貞觀中，為右屯衛兵曹參軍。

translations.literal: During the Zhenguan era he served as military registrar of the Right Vanguard Guard.
translations.idiomatic: During the Zhenguan era he served as military registrar of the Right Vanguard Guard.

sentences.zh: 太宗將征遼東，募使高麗者，眾皆畏憚。

translations.literal: When Taizong was about to campaign in Liaodong he recruited envoys to Goguryeo; everyone feared and hesitated.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizong was about to campaign in Liaodong he recruited envoys to Goguryeo; everyone feared and hesitated.

sentences.zh: 儼謂人曰：「主上雄略，華夷畏威，高麗小蕃，豈敢圖其使者。

translations.literal: Yan said to people: "Our lord is strategically bold; Chinese and barbarians alike fear his authority—Goguryeo is a petty tribe; how would it dare plot against his envoy?
translations.idiomatic: Yan said to people, "Our lord is strategically bold; Chinese and barbarians alike fear his authority—Goguryeo is a petty tribe; how would it dare plot against his envoy?

sentences.zh: 縱其淩虐，亦是吾死所也。

translations.literal: Even if they should mistreat me, that too would be a place for me to die.
translations.idiomatic: Even if they should mistreat me, that too would be a place for me to die.

sentences.zh: 」遂出請行。

translations.literal: " Thereupon he stepped forward and requested to go.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon he stepped forward and requested to go.

sentences.zh: 及至高麗，莫離支置於窟室中，脅以兵刃，終不屈撓。

translations.literal: Upon reaching Goguryeo, Molizhi placed him in a cave dwelling and threatened him with weapons, but he never yielded or wavered.
translations.idiomatic: Upon reaching Goguryeo, Molizhi placed him in a cave dwelling and threatened him with weapons, but he never yielded or wavered.

sentences.zh: 會高麗敗，得歸。

translations.literal: When Goguryeo was defeated he was able to return.
translations.idiomatic: When Goguryeo was defeated he was able to return.

sentences.zh: 太宗奇之，拜朝散大夫。

translations.literal: Taizong marveled at this and appointed him Gentleman for Promoting Morals.
translations.idiomatic: Taizong marveled at this and appointed him Gentleman for Promoting Morals.

sentences.zh: 再遷幽州司馬。

translations.literal: After a second transfer he became military registrar of Youzhou.
translations.idiomatic: After a second transfer he became military registrar of Youzhou.

sentences.zh: 以善政為巡察使劉祥道所薦，擢為會州刺史。

translations.literal: Recommended for good governance by the inspection commissioner Liu Xiangdao, he was promoted to prefect of Kuaiji.
translations.idiomatic: Recommended for good governance by the inspection commissioner Liu Xiangdao, he was promoted to prefect of Kuaiji.

sentences.zh: 再遷殿中少監，數陳意見，高宗每優納之。

translations.literal: After a second transfer he became Vice Superintendent of the Palace Department; he repeatedly presented opinions, and Emperor Gaozong each time graciously accepted them.
translations.idiomatic: After a second transfer he became Vice Superintendent of the Palace Department; he repeatedly presented opinions, and Emperor Gaozong each time graciously accepted them.

sentences.zh: 再轉蒲州刺史。

translations.literal: After another transfer he became prefect of Puzhou.
translations.idiomatic: After another transfer he became prefect of Puzhou.

sentences.zh: 蒲州戶口殷劇，前後刺史，多不稱職。

translations.literal: Puzhou had a dense and thriving population; prefects before and after mostly did not perform their duties well.
translations.idiomatic: Puzhou had a dense and thriving population; prefects before and after mostly did not perform their duties well.

sentences.zh: 儼下車未幾，令行禁止，稱為良牧。

translations.literal: Yan had barely taken up his post when orders were obeyed and prohibitions enforced; he was praised as a worthy governor.
translations.idiomatic: Yan had barely taken up his post when orders were obeyed and prohibitions enforced; he was praised as a worthy governor.

sentences.zh: 儼尋檢校太常卿。

translations.literal: Yan was soon appointed acting Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Yan was soon appointed acting Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 文明中，封義興縣子，歷右衛大將軍、太子詹事，以年老致仕。

translations.literal: During the Wenming era he was enfeoffed as Viscount of Yixing; he served as Right Guard General and Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent, and retired due to old age.
translations.idiomatic: During the Wenming era he was enfeoffed as Viscount of Yixing; he served as Right Guard General and Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent, and retired due to old age.

sentences.zh: 垂拱三年卒於家，年七十八。

translations.literal: He died at home in the third year of Chuigong, at the age of seventy-eight.
translations.idiomatic: He died at home in the third year of Chuigong, at the age of seventy-eight.

sentences.zh: 文集五卷。

translations.literal: His collected writings numbered five scrolls.
translations.idiomatic: His collected writings numbered five scrolls.

sentences.zh: 王方翼，并州祁人也，高宗王庶人從祖兄也。

translations.literal: Wang Fangyi was a native of Qi in Bingzhou, a cousin of Empress Wang the Commoner of Emperor Gaozong.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Fangyi was a native of Qi in Bingzhou, a cousin of Empress Wang the Commoner of Emperor Gaozong.

sentences.zh: 祖裕，武德初隋州刺史。

translations.literal: His grandfather Yu, in the early Wude era, was prefect of Sui.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Yu, in the early Wude era, was prefect of Sui.

sentences.zh: 裕妻即高祖妹同安大長公主也。

translations.literal: Yu's wife was the Grand Princess of Tong'an, a younger sister of Gaozu.
translations.idiomatic: Yu's wife was the Grand Princess of Tong'an, a younger sister of Gaozu.

sentences.zh: 太宗時，以公主屬尊年老，特加敬異，數幸其第，賞賜累萬。

translations.literal: During the Taizong era, because the princess held exalted rank in her advanced years, special respect was shown her; the emperor often visited her residence and gifts totaled tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: During the Taizong era, because the princess held exalted rank in her advanced years, special respect was shown her; the emperor often visited her residence and gifts totaled tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 方翼父仁表，貞觀中為岐州刺史。

translations.literal: Fangyi's father Renbiao, during the Zhenguan era, was prefect of Qi.
translations.idiomatic: Fangyi's father Renbiao, during the Zhenguan era, was prefect of Qi.

sentences.zh: 仁表卒，妻李氏為主所斥，居於鳳泉別業。

translations.literal: When Renbiao died, his wife Lady Li was expelled by the princess and lived at the Fengquan estate.
translations.idiomatic: When Renbiao died, his wife Lady Li was expelled by the princess and lived at the Fengquan estate.

sentences.zh: 時方翼尚幼，乃與傭保齊力勤作，苦心計。

translations.literal: Fangyi was still young; together with hired laborers he toiled diligently and planned with bitter effort.
translations.idiomatic: Fangyi was still young; together with hired laborers he toiled diligently and planned with bitter effort.

sentences.zh: 功不虛棄，數年辟田數十頃，修飾館宇，列植竹木，遂為富室。

translations.literal: His labor was not in vain; within several years he opened several tens of qing of fields, repaired buildings, and lined them with bamboo and trees, becoming a wealthy household.
translations.idiomatic: His labor was not in vain; within several years he opened several tens of qing of fields, repaired buildings, and lined them with bamboo and trees, becoming a wealthy household.

sentences.zh: 公主卒後，歸長安。

translations.literal: After the princess died they returned to Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: After the princess died they returned to Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 友人趙持滿犯罪被誅，暴屍於城西，親戚莫敢收視。

translations.literal: His friend Zhao Chiman was executed for a crime; his corpse lay exposed west of the city and none of his kin dared to look after the burial.
translations.idiomatic: His friend Zhao Chiman was executed for a crime; his corpse lay exposed west of the city and none of his kin dared to look after the burial.

sentences.zh: 方翼嘆曰：「欒布之哭彭越，大義也；

translations.literal: Fangyi sighed: "Luan Bu weeping for Peng Yue was great righteousness;
translations.idiomatic: Fangyi sighed, "Luan Bu weeping for Peng Yue was great righteousness;

sentences.zh: 周文之掩朽骼，至仁也。

translations.literal: King Wen of Zhou covering exposed bones was supreme benevolence.
translations.idiomatic: King Wen of Zhou covering exposed bones was supreme benevolence.

sentences.zh: 絕友之義，蔽主之仁，何以事君？

translations.literal: To sever the bond of friendship and conceal the lord's benevolence—how could one then serve the ruler?
translations.idiomatic: To sever the bond of friendship and conceal the lord's benevolence—how could one then serve the ruler?

sentences.zh: 」乃收其屍，具禮葬之。

translations.literal: " He collected the corpse and buried it with full rites.
translations.idiomatic: " He collected the corpse and buried it with full rites.

sentences.zh: 高宗聞而嘉嘆，由是知名。

translations.literal: Emperor Gaozong heard of this, sighed in admiration, and Fangyi thereby became known.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Gaozong heard of this, sighed in admiration, and Fangyi thereby became known.

sentences.zh: 永徽中累授安定令。

translations.literal: During the Yonghui era he was repeatedly appointed magistrate of Anding.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yonghui era he was repeatedly appointed magistrate of Anding.

sentences.zh: 誅大姓皇甫氏，盜賊止息，號為善政。

translations.literal: He executed the great clan the Huangfu and bandits ceased; his administration was praised as good governance.
translations.idiomatic: He executed the great clan the Huangfu and bandits ceased; his administration was praised as good governance.

sentences.zh: 五遷肅州刺史。

translations.literal: After five promotions he became prefect of Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: After five promotions he became prefect of Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 時州城荒毀，又無壕塹，數為寇賊所乘。

translations.literal: At the time the prefectural city was ruined and desolate and there was no moat; repeatedly it was exploited by bandits and raiders.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the prefectural city was ruined and desolate and there was no moat; repeatedly it was exploited by bandits and raiders.

sentences.zh: 方翼發卒浚築，引多樂水環城為壕。

translations.literal: Fangyi dispatched troops to dig and build, channeling the Duole River around the city as a moat.
translations.idiomatic: Fangyi dispatched troops to dig and build, channeling the Duole River around the city as a moat.

sentences.zh: 又出私財造水碾硙，稅其利以養饑餒，宅側起舍十余行以居之。

translations.literal: He also spent private funds to build water-powered mills, taxed their profit to sustain the hungry, and erected more than ten rows of dwellings beside his residence to house them.
translations.idiomatic: He also spent private funds to build water-powered mills, taxed their profit to sustain the hungry, and erected more than ten rows of dwellings beside his residence to house them.

sentences.zh: 屬蝗儉，諸州貧人死於道路，而肅州全活者甚眾，州人為立碑頌美。

translations.literal: When locusts and famine struck, poor people in other commands died on the roads, but in Suzhou very many were fully kept alive; the people of the command erected a stele praising him.
translations.idiomatic: When locusts and famine struck, poor people in other commands died on the roads, but in Suzhou very many were fully kept alive; the people of the command erected a stele praising him.

sentences.zh: 會吏部侍郎裴行儉西討遮匐，奏方翼為副，兼檢校安西都護。

translations.literal: When the Vice Minister of Personnel Pei Xingjian marched west to attack Zhefu, he memorialized Fangyi as his deputy, concurrently serving as acting Protector-General of Anxi.
translations.idiomatic: When the Vice Minister of Personnel Pei Xingjian marched west to attack Zhefu, he memorialized Fangyi as his deputy, concurrently serving as acting Protector-General of Anxi.

sentences.zh: 又築碎葉鎮城，立四面十二門，皆屈曲作隱伏出沒之狀，五旬而畢。

translations.literal: He also built Suyab Fort, erecting twelve gates on four sides, all curved in concealed patterns of appearing and disappearing, completed in fifty days.
translations.idiomatic: He also built Suyab Fort, erecting twelve gates on four sides, all curved in concealed patterns of appearing and disappearing, completed in fifty days.

sentences.zh: 西域諸胡競來觀之，因獻方物。

translations.literal: Various barbarian tribes of the Western Regions competed to come and observe, and thereby presented local products.
translations.idiomatic: Various barbarian tribes of the Western Regions competed to come and observe, and thereby presented local products.

sentences.zh: 永隆中，車簿反叛，圍弓月城。

translations.literal: During the Yonglong era Chebo rebelled and besieged Gongyue City.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yonglong era Chebo rebelled and besieged Gongyue City.

sentences.zh: 方翼引兵救之，至伊麗河。

translations.literal: Fangyi led troops to the rescue and reached the Ili River.
translations.idiomatic: Fangyi led troops to the rescue and reached the Ili River.

sentences.zh: 賊前來拒，因縱擊。

translations.literal: The enemy came forward to resist and he thereupon launched an attack.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy came forward to resist and he thereupon launched an attack.

sentences.zh: 大破之，斬首千余級。

translations.literal: He routed them completely and took more than a thousand heads.
translations.idiomatic: He routed them completely and took more than a thousand heads.

sentences.zh: 俄而二姓咽曲悉發眾十萬，與車簿合勢，以拒方翼。

translations.literal: Before long the two surnames of Yanqu mustered one hundred thousand men and joined forces with Chebo to resist Fangyi.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the two Yanqu clans mustered one hundred thousand men and joined forces with Chebo to resist Fangyi.

sentences.zh: 屯兵熱海，與賊連戰，流矢貫臂，徐以佩刀截之，左右莫有覺者。

translations.literal: He encamped at Hot Lake and fought the enemy in succession; a stray arrow pierced his arm and he slowly cut it off with his belt knife—none of those beside him noticed.
translations.idiomatic: He encamped at Hot Lake and fought the enemy in succession; a stray arrow pierced his arm and he slowly cut it off with his belt knife—none of those beside him noticed.
