sentences.zh: 既而所將蕃兵懷貳，謀執方翼以應賊。

translations.literal: Before long the tribal troops he commanded harbored divided loyalties and plotted to seize Fangyi to join the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the tribal troops he commanded harbored divided loyalties and plotted to seize Fangyi to join the enemy.

sentences.zh: 方翼密知之，悉召會議，佯出軍資以賜之。

translations.literal: Fangyi secretly learned of this, summoned them all to a council, and pretended to distribute army supplies as gifts to them.
translations.idiomatic: Fangyi secretly learned of this, summoned them all to a council, and pretended to distribute army supplies as gifts to them.

sentences.zh: 續續引去，便令斬之。

translations.literal: As they departed one by one, he had them beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: As they departed one by one, he had them beheaded.

sentences.zh: 會大風，又振金鼓以亂其聲，遂誅七千余人。

translations.literal: A great wind arose, and he also struck gongs and drums to confuse the sound; thereupon more than seven thousand were executed.
translations.idiomatic: A great wind arose, and he also struck gongs and drums to confuse the sound; thereupon more than seven thousand were executed.

sentences.zh: 因遣裨將分道討襲咽曲等。

translations.literal: He then dispatched lieutenant generals along separate routes to pursue and attack Yanqu and the others.
translations.idiomatic: He then dispatched lieutenant generals along separate routes to pursue and attack Yanqu and the others.

sentences.zh: 賊既無備，因是大潰，擒首領突騎施等三百人，西域遂定。

translations.literal: The enemy, unprepared, thereupon collapsed in great disorder; three hundred chieftains including the Turgesh were captured, and the Western Regions were settled.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy, unprepared, thereupon collapsed in great disorder; three hundred chieftains including the Turgesh were captured, and the Western Regions were settled.

sentences.zh: 以功遷夏州都督。

translations.literal: For his merit he was transferred to area commander of Xiazhou.
translations.idiomatic: For his merit he was transferred to area commander of Xiazhou.

sentences.zh: 屬牛疫，無以營農，方翼造人耕之法，施關鍵，使人推之，百姓賴焉。

translations.literal: When cattle plague struck and there was no way to farm, Fangyi devised a method of human plowing, fitting it with a pivot so that people could push it—the common people relied upon this.
translations.idiomatic: When cattle plague struck and there was no way to farm, Fangyi devised a method of human plowing, fitting it with a pivot so that people could push it—the common people relied upon this.

sentences.zh: 永淳二年，詔征方翼，將議西域之事，於奉天宮謁見，賜食與語。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongchun an edict summoned Fangyi to discuss matters of the Western Regions; he had an audience at Fengtian Palace, was granted food, and conversed with the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Yongchun an edict summoned Fangyi to discuss matters of the Western Regions; he had an audience at Fengtian Palace, was granted food, and conversed with the emperor.

sentences.zh: 方翼衣有舊時血漬之處，高宗問其故，方翼具對熱海苦戰之狀。

translations.literal: On Fangyi's clothing were old bloodstains; Emperor Gaozong asked the reason, and Fangyi fully recounted the bitter fighting at Hot Lake.
translations.idiomatic: On Fangyi's clothing were old bloodstains; Emperor Gaozong asked the reason, and Fangyi fully recounted the bitter fighting at Hot Lake.

sentences.zh: 高宗使袒視其瘡，嘆曰：「吾親也。

translations.literal: Gaozong had him bare his body to show the scars and sighed: "You are my kin.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozong had him bare his body to show the scars and sighed, "You are my kin.

sentences.zh: 」賞賜甚厚。

translations.literal: " He was rewarded very generously.
translations.idiomatic: " He was rewarded very generously.

sentences.zh: 俄屬綏州白鐵余舉兵反，乃詔方翼副程務挺討之。

translations.literal: Soon afterward Bai Tieyu of Suizhou rose in rebellion; Fangyi was ordered to serve as deputy to Cheng Wuting in suppressing him.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Bai Tieyu of Suizhou rose in rebellion; Fangyi was ordered to serve as deputy to Cheng Wuting in suppressing him.

sentences.zh: 賊平，封太原郡公。

translations.literal: When the rebels were pacified he was enfeoffed as Duke of Taiyuan Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels were pacified he was enfeoffed as Duke of Taiyuan Commandery.

sentences.zh: 則天臨朝，以方翼是庶人近屬，陰欲除之。

translations.literal: When Zetian assumed the throne, because Fangyi was a close relative of the deposed empress, she secretly wished to eliminate him.
translations.idiomatic: When Zetian assumed the throne, because Fangyi was a close relative of the deposed empress, she secretly wished to eliminate him.

sentences.zh: 及程務挺被誅，以方翼與務挺連職素善，追赴都下獄，遂流於崖州而死。

translations.literal: When Cheng Wuting was executed, because Fangyi had long been on good terms with Wuting through linked office, he was summoned to the capital, thrown into prison, exiled to Yazhou, and died there.
translations.idiomatic: When Cheng Wuting was executed, because Fangyi had long been on good terms with Wuting through linked office, he was summoned to the capital, thrown into prison, exiled to Yazhou, and died there.

sentences.zh: 子寶、珣、瑨，並知名。

translations.literal: His sons Bao, Xun, and Jin were all well known.
translations.idiomatic: His sons Bao, Xun, and Jin were all well known.

sentences.zh: 寶、瑨，開元中皆為中書舍人；

translations.literal: Bao and Jin, during the Kaiyuan era, both served as Drafting Officers of the Secretariat;
translations.idiomatic: Bao and Jin, during the Kaiyuan era, both served as Drafting Officers of the Secretariat;

sentences.zh: 珣，至秘書監。

translations.literal: Xun reached the post of Director of the Palace Library.
translations.idiomatic: Xun reached the post of Director of the Palace Library.

sentences.zh: 薛季昶，絳州龍門人也。

translations.literal: Xue Jichang was a native of Longmen in Jiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Jichang was a native of Longmen in Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 則天初，上封事，解褐拜監察御史。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Zetian's reign he submitted a sealed memorial and, leaving the commoner ranks, was appointed investigating censor.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Zetian's reign he submitted a sealed memorial and, leaving the commoner ranks, was appointed investigating censor.

sentences.zh: 頻按制獄稱旨，累遷御史中丞。

translations.literal: He repeatedly handled imperial prisons to the emperor's satisfaction and was successively promoted to Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: He repeatedly handled imperial prisons to the emperor's satisfaction and was successively promoted to Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 萬歲通天元年，夏官郎中侯味虛統兵討契丹不利，奏言「賊徒熾盛，常有蛇虎導其軍」。

translations.literal: In the first year of Wansui Tongtian, the Director of the Ministry of War Hou Weiwei commanded troops against the Khitan without success and memorialized that "the bandits are flourishing and snakes and tigers constantly guide their army."
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Wansui Tongtian, the Director of the Ministry of War Hou Weiwei commanded troops against the Khitan without success and memorialized that "the bandits are flourishing and snakes and tigers constantly guide their army."

sentences.zh: 則天命季昶按驗其狀，便為河北道按察使。

translations.literal: Zetian ordered Jichang to investigate and verify the matter, and he was appointed inspection commissioner of the Hebei Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Zetian ordered Jichang to investigate and verify the matter, and he was appointed inspection commissioner of the Hebei Circuit.

sentences.zh: 季昶先馳至軍，斬味虛以聞。

translations.literal: Jichang first galloped to the army, beheaded Weiwei, and reported it.
translations.idiomatic: Jichang first galloped to the army, beheaded Weiwei, and reported it.

sentences.zh: 又有槁城尉吳澤者，貪虐縱橫，嘗射殺驛使，截百姓子女發以為髢，州將不能制，甚為人吏所患。

translations.literal: There was also the Gaocheng magistrate Wu Ze, greedy and cruel and running rampant; he once shot and killed a courier, cut off the hair of commoners' sons and daughters to make wigs, and the prefect could not control him—he was greatly feared by officials and clerks.
translations.idiomatic: There was also the Gaocheng magistrate Wu Ze, greedy and cruel and running rampant; he once shot and killed a courier, cut off the hair of commoners' sons and daughters to make wigs, and the prefect could not control him—he was greatly feared by officials and clerks.

sentences.zh: 季昶又杖殺之。

translations.literal: Jichang also had him beaten to death.
translations.idiomatic: Jichang also had him beaten to death.

sentences.zh: 由是威震遠近，州縣望風懾懼。

translations.literal: Because of this his authority shook far and near; prefectures and counties cowered at the mere report of his approach.
translations.idiomatic: Because of this his authority shook far and near; prefectures and counties cowered at the mere report of his approach.

sentences.zh: 然後布以恩信，旌揚善吏。

translations.literal: Only then did he spread kindness and trust, commending worthy officials.
translations.idiomatic: Only then did he spread kindness and trust, commending worthy officials.

sentences.zh: 有汴州孝女李氏，年八歲，父卒，柩殯在堂十余載，每日哭臨無限。

translations.literal: There was the filial daughter of Bianzhou, Lady Li, aged eight when her father died; the coffin remained in the hall for more than ten years and each day she wept at it without limit.
translations.idiomatic: There was the filial daughter of Bianzhou, Lady Li, aged eight when her father died; the coffin remained in the hall for more than ten years and each day she wept at it without limit.

sentences.zh: 及年長，母欲嫁之。

translations.literal: When she grew older her mother wished to marry her off.
translations.idiomatic: When she grew older her mother wished to marry her off.

sentences.zh: 遂截發自誓，請在家終養。

translations.literal: She thereupon cut off her hair and vowed, requesting to remain at home and complete her mourning.
translations.idiomatic: She thereupon cut off her hair and vowed, requesting to remain at home and complete her mourning.

sentences.zh: 及喪母，號毀殆至滅性，家無丈夫，自營棺槨，州裏欽其至孝，送葬者千余人。

translations.literal: When her mother died she wailed and grieved nearly to the point of destroying her life; the household had no men, yet she herself prepared the coffin; the district admired her supreme filial piety and more than a thousand people attended the burial.
translations.idiomatic: When her mother died she wailed and grieved nearly to the point of destroying her life; the household had no men, yet she herself prepared the coffin; the district admired her supreme filial piety and more than a thousand people attended the burial.

sentences.zh: 葬畢，廬於墓側，蓬頭跣足，負土成墳，手植松柏數百株。

translations.literal: When the burial was complete she built a hut beside the tomb, with disheveled hair and bare feet, carrying earth to form the mound and planting several hundred pine and cypress trees by hand.
translations.idiomatic: When the burial was complete she built a hut beside the tomb, with disheveled hair and bare feet, carrying earth to form the mound and planting several hundred pine and cypress trees by hand.

sentences.zh: 季昶列上其狀，有制特表門閭，賜以粟帛。

translations.literal: Jichang submitted a detailed report of her case; by imperial decree her gate and lane were specially honored and she was granted grain and silk.
translations.idiomatic: Jichang submitted a detailed report of her case; by imperial decree her gate and lane were specially honored and she was granted grain and silk.

sentences.zh: 久視元年，季昶自定州刺史入為雍州長史，威名甚著，前後京尹，無及之者。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiushi, Jichang entered the capital from prefect of Dingzhou to serve as chief administrator of Yongzhou; his reputation for authority was very great—none of the capital governors before or after could match him.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jiushi, Jichang entered the capital from prefect of Dingzhou to serve as chief administrator of Yongzhou; his reputation for authority was very great—none of the capital governors before or after could match him.

sentences.zh: 俄遷文昌左丞，歷魏、陜二州刺史。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was transferred to Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and served as prefect of Wei and Shan.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was transferred to Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and served as prefect of Wei and Shan.

sentences.zh: 長安末，為洛州長史，所在皆以嚴肅為政。

translations.literal: At the end of the Chang'an era he served as chief administrator of Luozhou; wherever he served he governed with severity and austerity.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Chang'an era he served as chief administrator of Luozhou; wherever he served he governed with severity and austerity.

sentences.zh: 神龍初，以預誅張易之兄弟功，加銀青光祿大夫，拜戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the early Shenlong era, for his merit in the execution of Zhang Yizhi and his brother, he was granted the title of Silver-Green Glory Grand Master and appointed Vice Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Shenlong era, for his merit in the execution of Zhang Yizhi and his brother, he was granted the title of Silver-Green Glory Grand Master and appointed Vice Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 時季昶勸敬暉等因兵勢殺武三思。

translations.literal: At the time Jichang urged Jing Hui and the others to use their military strength to kill Wu Sansi.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Jichang urged Jing Hui and the others to use their military strength to kill Wu Sansi.

sentences.zh: 暉等不從，竟以此敗，語在《暉傳》。

translations.literal: Hui and the others did not follow his advice and in the end failed because of this—as told in the Biography of Hui.
translations.idiomatic: Hui and the others did not follow his advice and in the end failed because of this—as told in the Biography of Hui.

sentences.zh: 季昶亦因是累貶，自桂州都督授儋州司馬。

translations.literal: Jichang was also demoted in succession because of this, from area commander of Guizhou to military registrar of Danzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Jichang was also demoted in succession because of this, from area commander of Guizhou to military registrar of Danzhou.

sentences.zh: 初，季昶與昭州首領周慶立及廣州司馬光楚客不協。

translations.literal: Earlier Jichang had been on bad terms with the Zhao chieftain Zhou Qingli and the Guangzhou military registrar Zong Chuke.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Jichang had been on bad terms with the Zhao chieftain Zhou Qingli and the Guangzhou military registrar Zong Chuke.

sentences.zh: 及將之儋州，懼慶立見殺，將往廣州，又惡楚客，乃嘆曰：「薛季昶行事至是耶！

translations.literal: When he was about to go to Danzhou he feared Qingli would be killed; if he went to Guangzhou he again hated Chuke, and sighed: "Has Xue Jichang's conduct come to this!
translations.idiomatic: When he was about to go to Danzhou he feared Qingli would be killed; if he went to Guangzhou he again hated Chuke, and sighed, "Has Xue Jichang's conduct come to this!

sentences.zh: 」因自制棺，仰藥而死。

translations.literal: " He thereupon made his own coffin and died by taking poison.
translations.idiomatic: " He thereupon made his own coffin and died by taking poison.

sentences.zh: 睿宗即位，下制曰：「故儋州司馬薛季昶，剛幹義烈。

translations.literal: When Emperor Ruizong ascended the throne he issued an edict saying: "The late military registrar of Danzhou, Xue Jichang, was resolute in action and righteous in spirit.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Ruizong ascended the throne he issued an edict saying, "The late military registrar of Danzhou, Xue Jichang, was resolute in action and righteous in spirit.

sentences.zh: 早承先顧，驅策中外，績譽昭宣；

translations.literal: Early he received the former emperor's favor, driving affairs at court and in the provinces; his achievements and reputation were widely proclaimed;
translations.idiomatic: Early he received the former emperor's favor, driving affairs at court and in the provinces; his achievements and reputation were widely proclaimed;

sentences.zh: 有莊、湯之推舉，同汲黯之強直。

translations.literal: he had the recommending spirit of Zhuang and Tang, and the uncompromising uprightness of Ji An.
translations.idiomatic: he had the recommending spirit of Zhuang and Tang, and the uncompromising uprightness of Ji An.

sentences.zh: 屬醜正操衡，除其異己，橫加竄責，卒至殂亡。

translations.literal: When the wicked held the scales of power and removed those unlike themselves, he was harshly exiled and punished, until at last he perished.
translations.idiomatic: When the wicked held the scales of power and removed those unlike themselves, he was harshly exiled and punished, until at last he perished.

sentences.zh: 言念忠冤，有懷嘉悼。

translations.literal: Thinking of his loyalty and wrongful death, we hold him in honored remembrance.
translations.idiomatic: Thinking of his loyalty and wrongful death, we hold him in honored remembrance.

sentences.zh: 可贈左御史大夫，仍同敬暉等例，與一子官。」

translations.literal: He may be posthumously granted the title of Left Censor-in-Chief, and following the precedent of Jing Hui and the others, one son may be granted an office."
translations.idiomatic: He may be posthumously granted the title of Left Censor-in-Chief, and following the precedent of Jing Hui and the others, one son may be granted an office."
